caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, pattern equal to form, closed color shapes, ornamental border, tapestry space, a fantastic fortress with a stone tower and black conical roof, high white walls and a great arched gate, domed palaces and minarets in the distance, soldiers in red armor with shields and spears on a covered walkway, palm trees, entwined snakes and white stars, ochre, cinnabar, malachite green, lapis blue, gold
notes_zh: Bilibin 城堡/宫殿群插图（边框为作品组成部分，不裁）。中央圆石防卫塔（黑锥顶、檐下彩鸟壁画）、右上白色高墙+木铁拱门（棕榈+双蛇图腾）、左上圆顶宣礼塔与宫殿天际线、左下斜顶长廊与红甲盾矛士兵队列。夜空墨黑/深蓝缀白星，石塔暖褐，米白+土黄，朱红/珊瑚红点缀，橄榄绿/墨绿棕榈，淡紫金棕卷草。主题定 court（§3.3 宫殿/城郭/仪仗）。不含风格/流派词。
